title: Freelance Content Specialist
description:
Footballco is building a next-generation football media company: one that goes deeper into distinct communities, develops original formats and intellectual property, and creates strong brands that can travel across platforms and markets.

Our multi-brand, multi-platform approach places us at the intersection of what audiences, commercial partners and traditional media companies increasingly want. We combine global scale with a deep understanding of individual fan communities and create entertainment and experiences that others cannot.

INDIVISA is central to that ambition, and we are now expanding our portfolio with a new culture-first brand designed to connect broader female audiences with sport. This is an opportunity to shape two distinct but complementary brands, and help define how the next generation of audiences discovers, experiences and connects with football and sport

About the Role

Footballco is looking for a Freelance Content Specialist to play a key role in the launch and development of Indivisa, a football media brand in Brazil.

This is an opportunity to help build a new editorial brand from the ground up, defining how it talks about football, connects with its audience and translates the biggest stories, personalities and cultural conversations around the game into compelling, platform-native content.

The Content Specialist will be responsible for the day-to-day editorial operation of the brand , with social media as the primary focus. Working closely with the project lead, they will help develop the content strategy and be responsible for turning it into editorial plans, formats and daily execution across platforms.

The role will also coordinate the day-to-day work of a designer and copywriter, ensuring the team delivers consistent, creative and high-quality content. While social media will be the priority, the wider editorial team will also contribute to articles and other content for the brand’s website.

We are looking for someone who combines strong knowledge of football with editorial judgement, creativity and a deep understanding of social media , and who is comfortable moving between planning, content creation, publishing and performance analysis.

What you’ll be doing

  • Help develop and execute the brand’s editorial and social media strategy , translating broader strategic goals into actionable content plans.
  • Own the day-to-day editorial calendar and social publishing operation , ensuring a consistent and relevant content cadence across platforms.
  • Lead content ideation around football, identifying stories, conversations, personalities, trends and cultural moments with the potential to engage Brazilian audiences.
  • Create and develop original social formats, from reactive and news-driven content to recurring franchises and larger editorial initiatives.
  • Coordinate the daily workflow of the designer and copywriter, providing clear briefs, feedback and editorial direction.
  • Write, edit and publish social content when required, ensuring accuracy and consistency with the brand’s tone of voice.
  • Plan and script short-form video and other multimedia content, working with designers, editors and other production resources when necessary.
  • Contribute to the production and editing of articles and editorial content for the website , alongside the wider content team.
  • Manage community engagement and help develop a distinctive relationship between the brand and its audience.
  • Monitor social and content performance, using data and audience insights to identify learnings and continuously improve the editorial strategy.
  • Stay on top of platform trends, emerging formats and changes in audience behaviour, identifying opportunities for experimentation and growth.
  • Identify opportunities to react quickly and creatively to breaking news, major football moments and relevant cultural conversations.
  • Support branded content and commercial projects, helping integrate partners into the brand in a way that remains credible and audience-first.
  • Work around major football moments when necessary, including occasional evening and weekend coverage.

What you have:

  • 3+ years of experience working with social media, digital content or editorial operations, ideally within sports, entertainment, culture or digital media.
  • Strong knowledge of and genuine interest in the indivisa brand , including its main competitions, clubs, players, storylines and the broader cultural conversations surrounding the game in Brazil and internationally.
  • Strong understanding of the major social platforms and what makes content successful across different formats and audiences.
  • Excellent written Portuguese , with the ability to write engaging, accurate copy and adapt tone according to platform and format.
  • Strong editorial judgement and the ability to identify which stories, conversations and moments matter to an audience.
  • A creative mindset and genuine interest in developing new formats rather than simply reproducing traditional sports coverage on social media.
  • Experience planning and managing editorial calendars and handling multiple pieces of content simultaneously.
  • Ability to brief and coordinate creative resources such as designers, writers and video editors.
  • Comfort working with social analytics and using performance data to inform editorial decisions.
  • Hands-on knowledge of content creation tools. Basic image and video editing skills are highly valued , including familiarity with tools used to quickly create or adapt social-first content.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritise tasks and make editorial decisions in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication and collaborative skills, with the ability to work across editorial, creative and commercial teams.
  • English or Spanish proficiency is a plus.

Footballco is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, and will not be discriminated against based on age, race, gender, colour, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability or any other protected category.

Apoiar as áreas comerciais e de pré-vendas na definição de escopo técnico e estimativas para novos projetos.

Responder pelo resultado financeiro (P&L de projeto) de cada cliente sob sua gestão.

Domínio de práticas ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e tradicionais (PMBOK).

description:
About Turing

Turing is an AI-powered tech services company with a mission to accelerate AGI advancement and deployment by bridging the gap between global talent from 100+ countries and the world's best foundational LLM companies, by helping them improve performance through model evaluation, fine-tuning, feedback, factuality and handling diverse data.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly creative and versatile Senior Artist / Graphic Designer with strong artistic fundamentals and the ability to work across a wide range of visual styles. In this role, you will produce bold, expressive, and character-driven visuals while maintaining the highest standards of quality, consistency, and execution. This position requires a balance of artistic creativity and technical precision, with a strong focus on generating dynamic visual assets, adapting quickly to diverse briefs, and documenting creative workflows in a structured manner.

  • Professional Experience: Hand-on experience as a Cartoonist, Illustrator, Visual Artist, or in a similar professional role.

  • Tool Proficiency: Mastery of digital art software including Procreate, Adobe Illustrator, and Adobe Photoshop.
  • Style Versatility: Proven ability to adapt, replicate, and maintain consistency across diverse art styles, such as:
  • Cartoon & Comic Art
  • Manga & Anime
  • Pop Art
  • Sticker Style
  • Sketching & Drawing
  • Execution & Communication: Exceptional portfolio showcasing visual versatility, strong written and verbal communication skills, high attention to detail, and efficient time management in meeting tight deadlines.

Required Qualification:

In this role, you will be responsible for building high-quality visual content and defining artistic standards. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

  • Asset Creation: Producing high-quality illustrations and visual assets based on detailed creative briefs.
  • Character & Graphic Design: Developing character-driven and graphic visuals across multiple styles (cartoon, manga/anime, pop art, sticker designs, and sketching).
  • Style Consistency: Producing multiple asset variations while ensuring strict consistency in style, composition, line work, and color balance.
  • Workflow & Metadata Documentation: Documenting artistic prompts, design workflows, and asset metadata in a clear, structured manner.
  • Collaboration & Iteration: Working closely with cross-functional teams, incorporating calibration feedback efficiently, and refining visual outputs.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, Illustration, Visual Communication, or a related creative field.
  • A comprehensive portfolio demonstrating a strong track record in multi-style digital illustration and asset creation.

Project Snapshot

  • Estimated earning potential of approximately $7hour.
  • Upto 12 weeks remote project.
  • Up to 40 hours/week; part-time artists working up to 20 hours/week are welcome
  • Paid in USD
  • Start after portfolio approval and onboarding.

Evaluation Process

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • Post portfolio review final selected candidates will be contacted with the next steps and onboarding requirements.

title: Research Especialist
description:
Role Overview

We have an exciting opportunity for someone to join us as a Research Especialist to work in a truly global environment to to join its Research & Market Intelligence team, turning first-hand field information into insights that support commercial, trading, and risk management decisions reporting jointly to GM Volcafe Brasil and Head of Research, Volcafe Global Research.

Volcafe Ltd is one of the world’s leading international green coffee trading companies, operating in over 20 countries globally. Our expertise spans green coffee procurement and preparation, sustainability, blending, quality control, risk management and export as well as importing and distribution. We supply the world’s major coffee roasters and retail distributors with their green coffee requirements, with significant strategic growth ambitions for the future.

Volcafe works across the whole green coffee supply chain to make coffee business better, together with our partners and employees. We have built and operate sustainable coffee supply chains across all our origins, addressing key economic, social and environmental issues in coffee farming communities. Our Volcafe Way farmer support programme engages with thousands of coffee farmers and provides a holistic response to the challenges they face.

This role will be working for Volcafe Brasil , base is Santos/SP; the job is substantially on the road. This is a highly hands-on position, with approximately 40–50% of working time spent travelling across Brazil’s coffee-producing regions , conducting farm visits, crop tours, farmer interviews, surveys, and crop assessments. Possibility to also be based in Varginha/MG.

We are part of Hartree Partners, LP a leading global merchant commodities firm facilitating the flow of energy, metals, agriculture, and environmental products across the full commodity supply chain, connecting producers and consumers. Hartree was founded in 1997, is jointly owned by senior management and funds managed by Oaktree Capital Management, LP, and employs around 5,000 individuals worldwide.

Key Accountabilities

  • Lead and actively participate in crop tours and crop assessments across Brazil’s main producing regions;
  • Conduct farm visits and interviews with farmers, cooperatives, agronomists, and other key stakeholders;
  • Develop Arabica and Conilon production estimates and supply & demand analysis;
  • Monitor stocks, exports, logistics flows, and key coffee market developments;
  • Assess the impact of weather, frost, drought, pests, diseases, and other production risks;
  • Coordinate and guide field researchers and structured research programs;
  • Produce market intelligence reports and analysis for the Trading desk and senior management;
  • Develop dashboards, structured datasets, and automated workflows using tools such as Power BI, Python, SQL, and AI solutions.

Skills and Experience

  • Degree in Agronomy or Agricultural Engineering; other quantitative backgrounds may be considered with strong and proven field research experience;
  • 5+ years of experience in agricultural commodity research, market analysis, or a trading-adjacent analytical role;
  • Recent and sustained hands-on experience with field visits, farmer surveys, and crop assessments;
  • Experience with production forecasting, supply & demand analysis, and market intelligence;
  • Advanced Excel skills and working knowledge of Power BI and Python or SQL;
  • Fluent Portuguese and English, both written and spoken;
  • Availability to travel approximately 40–50% of working time.

Preferred Experience

Experience in the coffee market , Brazil crop forecasting, field team coordination, exposure to trading desks and market risk discussions, Spanish language skills, and the application of AI tools to research automation.

We are looking for someone who combines strong agronomic knowledge, active field presence, and analytical capability, transforming information from producing regions into high-quality intelligence for business and trading decisions.

We recognise that talent comes in many forms, and we value potential just as much as experience. If this role excites you but you don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

Our Offer

We provide a fast-paced, stimulating and truly global environment, which will stretch your abilities and channel your talents. We also offer competitive salary and benefits combined with outstanding career development opportunities in one of the global leaders in soft commodity trading.

Our Values

Respect, Integrity, Meritocracy, Client Focus, Entrepreneurship

Volcafe shares the values of our parent company, ED&F Man Commodities. Our values define who we are. They are the fundamental beliefs that determine our actions and guide our behaviour. They influence the way we communicate and collaborate, and define the way we engage with our clients, partners, and communities.

Our Commitment

We are committed to maintaining a work environment where all employees are treated with dignity and respect. We provide equal opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, sex, gender, age, religion, ethnic or national origin, marital or civil partner status, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We are willing to make any reasonable adjustments throughout our recruitment process.

To apply you must have the right to work for the provided location.

  • Apoiar gestores em situações do dia a dia relacionadas a performance, feedback e conflitos;
  • Participar de discussões sobre estrutura organizacional, composição das equipes e necessidades de headcount;
  • Orientar líderes sobre políticas, práticas e processos de Recursos Humanos;
  • Desenvolver relacionamento próximo com as diferentes Business Units e lideranças da companhia;
  • Apoiar a identificação e retenção de talentos críticos para o negócio.

Performance & Talent Management

  • Estruturar e conduzir os ciclos de avaliação de performance;
  • Conduzir processos de promoção e revisão salarial, incluindo critérios e governança;
  • Apoiar planos de desenvolvimento individual e sucessão para posições críticas;
  • Participar da identificação de high performers e profissionais com potencial de crescimento;
  • Contribuir para a evolução das práticas de liderança e gestão de pessoas da Genesis.

People Analytics & Governance

  • Desenvolver e acompanhar indicadores estratégicos de RH (headcount, turnover, retenção, absenteísmo, time to hire, movimentações, entre outros);
  • Produzir análises e dashboards que apoiem decisões relacionadas à força de trabalho;
  • Apoiar o planejamento de headcount e orçamento de pessoas;
  • Garantir qualidade, integridade e confidencialidade das informações de RH;
  • Buscar oportunidades de automação e melhoria contínua dos processos da área.

O perfil que buscamos

Procuramos alguém com maturidade profissional para atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, próximo à liderança executiva e com alto nível de autonomia.

Essa pessoa precisa se sentir confortável tanto conduzindo uma admissão ou desligamento quanto discutindo com um executivo temas relacionados a performance, retenção ou estrutura organizacional.

Esperamos um profissional com forte senso de ownership, organização e capacidade de execução, mas que também tenha visão crítica para identificar oportunidades e construir soluções melhores.

Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida e generalista em Recursos Humanos;
  • Experiência relevante em posições sêniores de HR, People Operations, HR Business Partner ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento consistente das rotinas de Departamento Pessoal e legislação trabalhista brasileira;
  • Experiência com processos de admissão, desligamento, férias, benefícios e administração de pessoal;
  • Capacidade de conferir e controlar processos relacionados à folha de pagamento;
  • Vivência no atendimento e aconselhamento de gestores;
  • Experiência com gestão de performance e desenvolvimento de pessoas;
  • Capacidade analítica e familiaridade com indicadores de RH;
  • Excelente organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Maturidade para conduzir conversas confidenciais e situações sensíveis;
  • Perfil hands-on e orientado à resolução de problemas.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em empresas de tecnologia, consultorias, serviços profissionais ou ambientes B2B;
  • Experiência em organizações em fase de crescimento ou profissionalização;
  • Experiência com People Analytics e construção de dashboards;
  • Vivência na implantação ou evolução de HRIS e ferramentas de Recursos Humanos;
  • Experiência com estruturas compostas por profissionais alocados em clientes, squads ou projetos;
  • Conhecimento de práticas de remuneração e estruturação de cargos e salários;
  • Experiência com planejamento de headcount;
  • Inglês profissional.

Competências que valorizamos

Ownership — Capacidade de assumir responsabilidade pelo resultado, e não apenas pela execução de tarefas.

Business Acumen — Entendimento de que decisões relacionadas a pessoas precisam estar conectadas às prioridades e aos resultados do negócio.

Hands-on Leadership — Disposição para executar diretamente quando necessário, independentemente da senioridade.

Structured Thinking — Capacidade de transformar problemas pouco estruturados em processos, critérios e soluções claras.

Confidentiality & Judgment — Elevado nível de discrição, confiança e capacidade de julgamento em situações sensíveis.

Continuous Improvement — Mentalidade orientada à evolução contínua dos processos e da experiência das pessoas.

Data-Driven Mindset — Capacidade de utilizar indicadores e evidências para apoiar decisões de gestão de pessoas.

O desafio

A Genesis está evoluindo sua estrutura, processos e modelo de gestão para suportar uma nova fase de crescimento.

O desafio desta posição não é simplesmente administrar Recursos Humanos. Esperamos que o(a) Senior HR & People Partner contribua para construir uma área de People & Culture cada vez mais estruturada, orientada por dados, próxima do negócio e capaz de suportar a evolução da organização.

Por isso, buscamos alguém que queira combinar execução, construção e influência, assumindo progressivamente desafios de maior complexidade e responsabilidade dentro da companhia.

description:

  • Criar e aprimorar dashboards e relatórios gerenciais utilizando Excel avançado, Power BI ou ferramentas similares;
  • Realizar análises de variação (real vs. budget/forecast), identificando causas-raiz dos desvios e apresentando insights;
  • Garantir a integridade e consistência dos dados, atuando como um pilar de confiança nas informações gerenciais;
  • Apoiar diretamente a liderança com análises detalhadas e recomendações estratégicas.

O que você precisa para se destacar:

  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência comprovada em instituições financeiras, com conhecimento em produtos financeiros de varejo (crédito imobiliário, veículos, entre outros);
  • Domínio em Excel avançado (fórmulas complexas, tabelas dinâmicas, macros);
  • Vivência prática em modelagem financeira, projeções e análise de cenários;
  • Experiência com Power BI ou outras ferramentas de visualização de dados;
  • Trajetória sólida em processos de budget, forecast e análise de variação;
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva para traduzir números em insights acionáveis para diferentes áreas.

Perfil comportamental desejado:

  • Analítico e orientado a resultados , com uma mente curiosa para descobrir o “porquê” por trás dos números;
  • Proativo, com iniciativa para identificar oportunidades de melhoria e otimização de processos;
  • Organizado, metódico e com extrema atenção aos detalhes;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com agilidade sob pressão e cumprir prazos desafiadores;
  • Visão estratégica, sempre conectando as análises aos objetivos de negócio.

Esta oportunidade é para você se:

Você é um(a) profissional que vai além do relatório, buscando o impacto real dos números. Se você combina profundidade técnica em finanças e ferramentas de análise com a capacidade de comunicar ideias de forma eficaz e apoiar decisões, queremos conhecê-lo(a)!

Envie seu currículo ou conecte-se comigo por aqui para uma conversa inicial. Para detalhes mais específicos sobre o escopo da posição, também podemos conectar você diretamente com a gestora da área.

title: Consultor(a) Sênior de Tributos Indiretos - Florianópolis
description:
Você na Deloitte

Você terá a oportunidade de evoluir sua carreira na maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo atuando como Consultor(a) Sênior de Tributos Indireto s no time de Tax . Na sua rotina, você irá:

  • Interpretar e aplicar a legislação tributária vigente, assegurando compliance, mitigação de riscos e aderência regulatória ;
  • Elaborar pareceres técnicos, memorandos e apresentações executivas , apoiando a tomada de decisão de clientes e stakeholders;
  • Atuar em projetos de consultoria tributária , incluindo revisões fiscais, planejamento tributário, implementação de melhorias operacionais, recuperação de créditos e temas relacionados à reforma tributária;
  • Desenvolver relacionamento próximo com clientes, atuando como parceiro estratégico do negócio e identificando oportunidades de agregação de valor;
  • Apoiar e orientar profissionais menos experientes, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento da equipe e disseminação de conhecimento técnico;
  • Monitorar mudanças na legislação e tendências do mercado, avaliando impactos e propondo soluções estruturadas para os clientes.

Prezamos pelos In-Person Moments that Matter (momentos presenciais que importam) e, com isso, o modelo de trabalho adotado é o Digital Workplace , ou seja, em trabalho híbrido (remoto e presencial) com frequência de idas presenciais adaptadas de acordo com a necessidade da área. Na Consultoria Tributária, o time atua 3 (três) vezes por semana em formato presencial, sejam nas dependências físicas dos escritórios da Deloitte ou de nossos clientes.

Na Deloitte, buscamos pessoas que queiram gerar impactos positivos todos os dias. Impulsionamos talentos para que possam se desenvolver em um ambiente colaborativo, com times diversos e que tragam energia, empoderamento, interação e conexões. O nosso crescimento é exponencial porque os talentos que recrutamos possuem os nossos valores em suas essências.

Liderar o caminho, fomentar a inclusão, colaborar para mensurar impactos, servir com integridade e cuidar uns dos outros são pontos essenciais e inegociáveis para fortalecer ainda mais o nosso propósito.

Acreditamos na força dos talentos que preparamos. Eles transformam de fato, impactam organizações, impulsionam mais talentos e criam oportunidades. Que tal fazer parte da maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo? Escolha seu impacto.

O que precisa para você se candidatar à vaga?

  • Formação superior em Direito, Ciências Contábeis, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em tributos indiretos , preferencialmente adquirida em consultorias;
  • Experiência em ambiente consultivo, com gestão de múltiplos projetos e prazos;
  • Conhecimento avançado da legislação tributária brasileira e práticas de compliance fiscal ;
  • Inglês desejável para atuação em projetos e interações com clientes e stakeholders globais.

Esperamos você neste time!

title: Analista de Orçamentos

Estamos sempre procurando novas formas de integrar tecnologia e inovação para ajudar você a ter um estilo de vida mais ativo e saudável. E aí, topa o desafio junto com a gente?

O que nos move todos os dias?

Somos parte da mudança, transformando o cenário e trazendo mais qualidade para a vida de quem tá junto com a gente. Cada gotinha de suor é uma prova do nosso compromisso em inspirar e motivar todo mundo que quer uma vida mais ativa e saudável. A cada dia, começamos nossa jornada com aquecimento total, prontos para alcançar novos objetivos e viver o máximo.

Estamos em busca de um Analista de Orçamento Pleno , que será responsável por:

  • Realizar cotação de preço dos serviços, insumos e mão-de-obra utilizados na implantação de uma obra/expansão;
  • Responsável pela gestão da concorrência dos orçamentos, incluindo os terceiros homologados;
  • Realizar a contratação da obra para todas as disciplinas envolvidas;
  • Entendimento, crítica e ajuste do escopo de obras para iniciar a concorrência dos orçamentos;
  • Fazer homologação de novos fornecedores (Construtoras, fornecedores de material etc);
  • Leitura, avaliação e crítica dos projetos de arquitetura e complementares;

title: Talent Management
description:
Sobre a Flint

A Flint é um selo de edutainment que transforma educação em influência e influência em negócio. Criamos programas que misturam conteúdo, comunidade e inteligência aplicada para capacitar profissionais e empresas a usarem a linguagem das redes como ferramenta estratégica. 

Nossos projetos combinam storytelling, prática e pertencimento, com formatos digitais, linguagem viva e experiências pensadas para quem aprende fazendo. Trabalhamos com grandes marcas e criadores para transformar conhecimento em impacto real, ampliando vozes, repertórios e oportunidades

Sobre a posição

Na Flint, creators são parte central de muitos dos projetos que construímos para grandes marcas. Trabalhamos com diferentes perfis de talentos, creators independentes, empresários e agências, conectando essas relações a campanhas, conteúdos, experiências e projetos de longo prazo. Estamos procurando uma pessoa para assumir a frente de Talent Management , cuidando da relação entre a Flint e nosso ecossistema de creators e agências parceiras.

Essa pessoa será responsável por fazer a ponte entre Flint, creators, agências de talentos e nossos projetos para clientes , garantindo que toda essa relação aconteça de forma organizada, ágil e positiva.

É uma posição que combina relacionamento, negociação e operação . No dia a dia, essa pessoa vai participar desde os primeiros contatos com um creator ou sua agência, entendendo disponibilidade, interesse, escopo e valores, até a negociação, contratação e acompanhamento das entregas ao longo de uma campanha.

Também será responsável por garantir que todas as partes tenham clareza sobre briefings, escopo, prazos, aprovações, contratos, pagamentos e próximos passos , antecipando problemas e fazendo as conversas avançarem. Buscamos alguém capaz de construir boas relações com o mercado de creators . Alguém que saiba negociar sem desgastar uma parceria, cobrar sem perder proximidade e representar a Flint de maneira profissional em cada interação.

É uma posição para quem gosta de pessoas, mas também gosta de processo. Que consegue acompanhar muitas conversas ao mesmo tempo, sabe quando precisa acelerar uma negociação e entende que uma boa experiência para o creator também faz parte da qualidade do trabalho que entregamos aos nossos clientes.

Principais responsabilidades
  • Gerenciar o relacionamento cotidiano da Flint com creators, talentos, empresários e agências parceiras.
  • Conduzir contatos, consultas de disponibilidade e negociações comerciais com creators e seus representantes.
  • Negociar cachês, escopos, entregas, direitos de uso, exclusividades, prazos e demais condições de participação nos projetos.
  • Coordenar o fluxo entre creators, agências, time Flint e clientes durante campanhas e projetos.
  • Garantir que creators e parceiros recebam briefings, materiais, orientações e informações necessárias para cada entrega.
  • Acompanhar cronogramas, datas de publicação, aprovações, ajustes e demais milestones das campanhas.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com os times de atendimento, estratégia, conteúdo, produção e financeiro da Flint.
  • Organizar e acompanhar os processos de contratação, documentação, contratos, POs, notas fiscais e pagamentos junto às áreas responsáveis.
  • Manter informações, status e histórico das negociações e dos talentos organizados e atualizados.
  • Identificar riscos ou atrasos e atuar de forma proativa para destravar processos.
  • Ajudar a construir e fortalecer continuamente a rede de creators e parceiros da Flint.
Requisitos
  • Experiência com talent management, influencer marketing, creator partnerships, produção ou gestão de campanhas com creators.
  • Experiência em negociação comercial com talentos, empresários ou agências.
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação e relacionamento.
  • Organização e atenção a detalhes para acompanhar múltiplos projetos e negociações simultaneamente.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com cronogramas, processos e diferentes stakeholders.
  • Agilidade para resolver problemas e conduzir conversas de maneira autônoma.
  • Familiaridade com o funcionamento do mercado de creators, influenciadores e agências de talentos.
Diferenciais
  • Rede de relacionamento prévia com creators, empresários e agências.
  • Experiência com campanhas para grandes marcas.
  • Conhecimento sobre contratos de influência, direitos de imagem, mídia, exclusividade e licenciamento de conteúdo.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas e processos de gestão de creators e campanhas.
  • Interesse genuíno por creator economy, cultura digital e novas plataformas

title: Member of the Board of Advisors
description:
About the Company


Founded in 1950, Westfield FC has been an important part of its local football community for more than 75 years. Today, the club competes in the 8th tier of English football and is backed by an ambitious group of investors committed to building a sustainable, community-driven club with long-term growth potential. Our vision is to earn promotion through the English football pyramid and ultimately reach the English Football League through strategic investment, strong leadership, and community engagement. Westfield FC also competes in FA Cup and FA Trophy qualifying matches each season, providing exciting opportunities to showcase the club on a national stage while pursuing success both on and off the pitch.


Company Website:


About the Role: Member of the Board of Advisors


Westfield FC is seeking accomplished professionals, entrepreneurs, sports executives, investors, and football enthusiasts to join our Board of Advisors. Advisors will help promote the club, expand our network, identify strategic opportunities, and support the long-term growth of Westfield FC. This is an opportunity to become part of an ambitious ownership group working to build a successful football club for generations to come.


We are also actively seeking advisors from Brazil to help represent and support Westfield FC within their local market and networks.


Key Responsibilities


  • Promote Westfield FC within your professional and personal network.
  • Introduce potential sponsors, commercial partners, investors, and strategic relationships.
  • Provide strategic guidance on club growth, marketing, fundraising, commercial partnerships, and community engagement.
  • Support revenue-generating and brand-building initiatives when appropriate.
  • Participate in periodic advisory meetings and provide feedback on key priorities.

title: Recruiter
description:
Recruiter - Fluent in English | Remote


(POSITION TO AT LEAST 2 YEAR EXPERIENCED RECRUITER)


At Bluedot BPO Solutions, we connect top LATAM talent with high-performing U.S. teams. We are looking for an experienced and strategic Executive Recruiter to lead end-to-end hiring processes and support corporate talent acquisition for international clients.

This fully remote role offers daily exposure to the U.S. market and a clear growth path for professionals who want to build a long-term career in Talent Acquisition and HR leadership.


What We Offer


  • Compensation of R$5,000 + bonuses in USD
  • 100% remote, working directly with U.S. teams
  • Monday to Friday, 12PM – 21 PM (BRT)
  • Long-term position
  • Fast-track growth opportunities (Senior Recruiter, Lead, Manager)
  • International exposure and multicultural environment
  • Structured training and continuous coaching


Your Responsibilities


  • Manage full-cycle recruitment for corporate and strategic roles
  • Partner with stakeholders to align candidate profiles and hiring needs
  • Source, screen, and interview candidates for the U.S. market
  • Utilize tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter and ATS platforms
  • Manage and maintain healthy candidate pipelines
  • Ensure an excellent candidate experience end-to-end
  • Maintain consistent communication with hiring managers and candidates
  • Support strategic hiring initiatives for clients and internal teams


What We’re Looking For


  • 2+ year of experience with Recruitment/Hunting in the American market
  • Proven experience in end-to-end recruitment
  • Strong English communication skills (professional level)
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple requisitions
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and delivery-focused
  • Comfortable in fast-paced environments


Nice to Have


  • Background in corporate or executive recruitment
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter, Dynamics, or other ATS
  • Experience in high-volume or fast-paced hiring environments
  • Experience working with global stakeholders
  • Experience recruiting for international or U.S. clients is a strong plus



Technical Requirements


  • Two monitors
  • Laptop with i5/i7 (or equivalent) + 12GB RAM
  • High-speed internet
  • Headset with microphone
  • Quiet home office


Build your international career in Recruitment.


Work directly with U.S. teams and grow in a structured, high-performance environment.

title: Gerente geral - Presencial - Banco de Talentos
description:
Responsável pelo planejamento, organização, gerenciamento e controle de um Centro de Distribuição, envolvendo as áreas Comercial, Logística, Operações e Administrativa, atuando na orientação e acompanhamento de suas atividades e desempenho, garantindo o atingimento das metas estabelecidas, bem como contribuir para o aumento da participação da empresa no mercado, dentro dos prazos, legislação vigente, padrões de, através de adequada alocação de seus recursos humanos, técnicos e materiais.


Vaga de banco de currículos!


Principais Desafios


  • Assegurar a execução da estratégia comercial definida, garantindo a rentabilidade das operações comerciais, o desenvolvimento da área comercial e a ampliação do volume de negócios
  • Garantir em conjunto com a liderança logística e de transporte da unidade, as operações de Distribuição, mantendo o padrão de qualidade de armazenagem e de movimentação dos produtos, bem como a qualidade da entrega dos mesmos em todos os pontos de vendas
  • Garantir a exatidão dos estoques, produto acabado e ativo de giro sob sua responsabilidade, mediante execução das rotinas e monitoramento periódico dos inventários
  • Elaborar o orçamento anual das despesas do Centro de Distribuição, através de análise de históricos e previsões de crescimento, buscando atingir as metas traçadas para atingimento do lucro líquido e o aumento do market share, visando seu cumprimento em conformidade com as diretrizes estabelecidas pela empresa
  • Garantir a conferência dos caixas do CD bem como conferir o montante de valores enviados para área de controle assegurando a acuracidade financeira
  • Conduzir a gestão de pessoas mantendo a equipe capacitada, habilitada e motivada para realização dos trabalhos


Requisitos para o cargo:


  • Forte experiência em Gestão de Equipes de Vendas, Gestão Orçamentária, Administrativa e conhecimentos de rotinas Operações;
  • Para essa vaga é indispensável habilidade com negociações comerciais;
  • Ensino Superior Completo (desejável pós-graduação)
  • CNH B ativa;


Benefícios GP


  • Plano de saúde Coparticipativo (opcional)
  • Plano odontológico (opcional)
  • Desconto em farmácias
  • Seguro de vida
  • Wellhub (opcional)
  • Plano de saúde PET (opcional)
  • Telemedicina 24h (Gratuito)
  • Suporte Jurídico (Gratuito)
  • Nascer GP (Gratuito)
  • Suporte Financeiro (Gratuito)
  • Suporte Psicológico (Gratuito)
  • Suporte Social (Gratuito)
  • Coaching Saúde (Gratuito)
  • Programa Nascer GP (Gratuito)
  • Kit Natal
  • Desconto na compra de produtos
  • Produtos no mês de aniversário
  • Parcerias em faculdades C/ Desconto
  • Participação de lucros
  • Veículo como ferramenta de trabalho.

Responsável pelo planejamento, organização, gerenciamento e controle de um Centro de Distribuição, envolvendo as áreas Comercial, Logística, Operações e Administrativa, atuando na orientação e acompanhamento de suas atividades e desempenho, garantindo o atingimento das metas estabelecidas, bem como contribuir para o aumento da participação da empresa no mercado, dentro dos prazos, legislação vigente, padrões de, através de adequada alocação de seus recursos humanos, técnicos e materiais.


Vaga de banco de currículos!


Principais Desafios


  • Assegurar a execução da estratégia comercial definida, garantindo a rentabilidade das operações comerciais, o desenvolvimento da área comercial e a ampliação do volume de negócios
  • Garantir em conjunto com a liderança logística e de transporte da unidade, as operações de Distribuição, mantendo o padrão de qualidade de armazenagem e de movimentação dos produtos, bem como a qualidade da entrega dos mesmos em todos os pontos de vendas
  • Garantir a exatidão dos estoques, produto acabado e ativo de giro sob sua responsabilidade, mediante execução das rotinas e monitoramento periódico dos inventários
  • Elaborar o orçamento anual das despesas do Centro de Distribuição, através de análise de históricos e previsões de crescimento, buscando atingir as metas traçadas para atingimento do lucro líquido e o aumento do market share, visando seu cumprimento em conformidade com as diretrizes estabelecidas pela empresa
  • Garantir a conferência dos caixas do CD bem como conferir o montante de valores enviados para área de controle assegurando a acuracidade financeira
  • Conduzir a gestão de pessoas mantendo a equipe capacitada, habilitada e motivada para realização dos trabalhos


Requisitos para o cargo:


  • Forte experiência em Gestão de Equipes de Vendas, Gestão Orçamentária, Administrativa e conhecimentos de rotinas Operações;
  • Para essa vaga é indispensável habilidade com negociações comerciais;
  • Ensino Superior Completo (desejável pós-graduação)
  • CNH B ativa;

description:
JUNTE - SE À NOSSA COMUNIDADE DE TALENTOS!

Se você é comprometido, simples, objetivo, empreendedor, íntegro e respeita as pessoas em suas individualidades, com certeza tem a cara do Grupo Petrópolis.



O Grupo Petrópolis é a maior empresa de bebidas com capital 100% nacional. Produz as marcas de cerveja: Itaipava, Cabaré, Crystal, Lokal, Black Princess, Petra e Weltenburger, Brassaria Ampolis com otulo Cacildis, Biritis, Ditriguis e Forévi, as Vodkas Blue Sprit Ice e Nordka, a Cabaré Ice, os energéticos TNT Energy Drink e Magneto, o refrigerante It! Isotonico TNT sports Drinkse água Petra. O Grupo Petrópolis valoriza a diversidade e oferece oportunidade iguais a todos. Em nossos processos seletivos consideramos candidatos PCDs e de diferentes idades, gêneros, religiões e etnias



Temos vagas de vendedor externo em todo Brasil



Principais Desafios

  • Efetuar vendas de produtos comercializados pela Unidade de Negócio Distribuição, através de visitas regulares nos Ponto de Vendas (PDV’), bem como captação de novos clientes, visando atingir as metas e objetivos comerciais, dentro das normas estabelecidas pela Empresa.


  • Executar o planejamento do dia, por meio da utilização de aplicativos de vendas e verificação de indicadores e meta do dia (preços, volumes acumulados, clientes movimentados etc.) e domínio do calendário promocional e de campanhas em conformidade, para alavancar resultados comercial.


  • Realizar o planejamento prévio à entrada no Ponto de Venda (PDV), através da verificação de pendências do cliente (devoluções, cortes, duplicatas, bloqueio, cheques devolvidos, solicitações, etc.), da checagem do histórico e metas do cliente e da leitura da loja, verificando oportunidades de inserção de produtos, mix existente, equipamento de refrigeração, perfil do estabelecimento e posicionamento de preços em relação ao principal concorrente, visando adequado relacionamento com cliente para aumentar a presença do nosso portfólio.



Requisitos.

  • CNH e ter veículo próprio
  • Atendimento ao Cliente, Técnicas de Vendas e Cálculos Matemáticos.

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Bilingual English Teacher - Remote Role [T]
description:
Role Overview

We are currently inviting qualified ESL teachers to apply for a remote instructional role supporting international learners through our structured online teaching platform.


This is a contract-based teaching position offering self-managed scheduling within a professional global education environment.


Why Join Us

  • Remote teaching structure
  • Self-managed scheduling
  • Access to professional development opportunities
  • Supportive global educator network
  • Dedicated online teaching portal


Core Requirements

·      Bachelor’s Degree or higher

·      Recognized English teaching certification (TESOL / TEFL / TESL – CELTA or equivalent preferred)

·      Minimum of 2 years ESL teaching experience

·      Demonstrated commitment to professional growth and teaching excellence


Professional Qualifications (Preferred)

·      Advanced ESL qualifications (Level 5 equivalent or higher such as CELTA, TKT, DipTESOL, PGCE, MEd, PhDEd)

·      Continuous professional development (CPD) participation

·      Experience with international learners


Language Capability Requirements

·      English proficiency at CEFR C2 (or equivalent) is required

·      Proficiency in at least one additional language at CEFR B1+ or higher is strongly preferred


﻿Teaching Scope

You may support either young learners or adult learners depending on teaching allocation.


Students may include:

  • School-aged learners
  • University students
  • Working professionals
  • Adult learners seeking conversational fluency


All curriculum materials are provided and accessible in advance of teaching sessions.


Next Step

  • Qualified candidates are invited to submit their resume for review.

title: Video Creator
description:
Job Title: Video Creator / Creative Editor

Location: 100% Remote

Type: Contract

Compensation: Retainer that reflects experience, seniority and skill level, + bonuses.

Required Assessment:

Submission Form:

───────────────────────────────

916 Studios is a premium creative production company producing social-first content for brands, creators, agencies, and public companies. Our clients range from fast-scaling consumer brands to publicly listed companies, with projects including work for Google, Oracle and TikTok.

───────────────────────────────

THE ROLE:

We're looking for a multi-disciplinary Video Creator / Creative Editor who doesn’t wait to be told that something ‘could be better’. Video Creators produce high-performance content for social media, website and beyond, blending strategy, editing, motion, sound, and narrative into media that drives results, (not just views).

───────────────────────────────

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Edit premium short & long-form content for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, and X
  • Own projects end-to-end, from brief to final delivery
  • Act as your own creative director, i.e. source, create, or generate every asset if needed, including: graphics, motion, sound, etc, to cohesively serve the story
  • Build engaging hooks, retention and pacing
  • Adapt creative styles intelligently to different brands and audiences
  • Deliver strong first drafts

───────────────────────────────

COMPLETE THE ASSESSMENT AND APPLY IF YOU HAVE:

  • 5+ years of professional editing experience
  • A portfolio of social-first content that proves viewer-retention with links to work currently live on social media
  • Advanced Premiere Pro + working After Effects so that you can build from scratch, (not reliant on templates)
  • A strong sense of storytelling, with the ability to independently select and organise footage into a coherent, engaging narrative even without a provided script
  • The ability to work efficiently under pressure and at speed without compromising quality
  • Strong sense for design, photo editing, and branding
  • A strong sound design, colour grading, and audio mixing ability
  • A deep understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, and platform-native editing
  • Clean workflow habits: methodical, organised, no missed deadlines and excellent communication.

───────────────────────────────

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

  • You consistently deliver high-quality edits with meticulous attention to detail
  • Your first cuts are robust and require minimal revision (if any!)
  • You actively look for ways to improve content without being asked
  • You anticipate roadblocks and resolve issues independently before escalating
  • You meet deadlines consistently and flag potential delays early
  • You bring fresh ideas, formats, and techniques to every project

───────────────────────────────

WHY JOIN US:

  • 100% remote, flexible working
  • Full creative ownership from day one without micromanagement
  • International brands and creator campaigns
  • Performance bonuses + genuine path to a core creative role
  • Up-skilling with AI workflows and content systems

───────────────────────────────

HOW TO APPLY:

  • Complete the required creative assessment first:
  • Submit your assessment via this form:
  • IMPORTANT: Applications without a completed assessment will not be considered.

title: Project Manager - Civil Engineer
description:
We are seeking an experienced Project Manager – Marine Works who is willing to relocate to Africa to lead and oversee consultancy and site supervision activities for port and marine infrastructure projects. The successful candidate will manage project execution from planning through construction supervision, ensuring delivery within scope, schedule, budget, and quality standards.

This role requires strong technical expertise in port infrastructure, stakeholder coordination, contractor management, and on-site supervision experience.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and coordinate port and marine infrastructure projects.
  • Supervise consultancy and site supervision teams during project execution.
  • Monitor construction progress, quality, HSE compliance, and contract performance.
  • Review technical submissions, drawings, method statements, and project documentation.
  • Coordinate with clients, contractors, consultants, and regulatory authorities.
  • Ensure compliance with project specifications, standards, and timelines.
  • Prepare project reports, progress updates, and risk assessments.
  • Support procurement, budgeting, scheduling, and contract administration activities.
  • Lead site meetings and resolve technical and operational issues.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, or related field.
  • Minimum 15 years of experience in port, marine, or infrastructure projects.
  • Proven experience in consultancy and construction/site supervision roles.
  • Strong knowledge of port infrastructure, dredging, quay walls, terminals, and marine works.
  • Experience managing multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication and reporting skills.
  • Fluent in English
  • Proficiency in project management tools and MS Office.
  • PMP certification or equivalent is an advantage.

Preferred Skills

  • Leadership and team management
  • Contract administration
  • Risk and schedule management
  • Problem-solving and decision-making
  • Strong HSE awareness

title: Regulatory Compliance Manager (Crypto)
description:
Remote: Brazil - Remote

Full time


About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role

Our Compliance team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to manage conduct risk.

We’re looking for a Regulatory Compliance Manager to keep our consumer protection practice in compliance. You‘ll advise on crypto compliance requirements and related controls.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.


What you'll be doing

  • Developing and executing a world-class compliance framework, monitoring, and training programme
  • Supporting regulatory licence applications

title: Oportunidades de Estágio em Engenharia - Lajeado/RS
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O estágio é voltado para estudantes que desejam aprender na prática, se desenvolver profissionalmente e construir carreira em um ambiente colaborativo, inovador e com propósito.


Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de atuar em áreas estratégicas do negócio, contribuindo para projetos que impactam diretamente a vida das pessoas e o futuro do saneamento no Brasil.


Conheça algumas das áreas:


ENGENHARIAS

As áreas de engenharia atuam diretamente na operação, expansão e melhoria contínua dos serviços de saneamento, garantindo eficiência, inovação e impacto positivo para a população.

Como estagiário(a), você poderá atuar em:

  • Engenharia Civil;
  • Engenharia Ambiental e Sanitária;


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Estar regularmente matriculado em curso de graduação, formação prevista a partir de dezembro de 2027;
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com clareza e objetividade;
  • Organização, responsabilidade e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Perfil analítico, com interesse em processos e melhoria contínua;
  • Proatividade, colaboração e vontade de aprender;
  • Conhecimento em Pacote Office (Excel, PowerPoint e Word);
  • Residir em Lajeado/RS ou regiões próximas.


Informações adicionais


  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Gympass;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Kit office.

title: DGB Americas Training Manager South Latam
description:
DGB Americas Training Manager – South LATAM

DOLCE & GABBANA Beauty

Location : Brazil

Reporting to: Education Senior Manager


Role Mission

We are seeking a dynamic, strategic, and hands-on Training Manager to lead all education initiatives across South LATAM. This individual will be responsible for elevating brand knowledge, retail excellence, and client experience across Fragrance, Makeup, and Skincare categories

The role acts as the regional guardian of training excellence, ensuring that all distributor and travel retail markets are aligned with global brand standards while adapting programs to local needs. This person will not only execute training programs but also build long-term capabilities within distributor teams, driving sell-out performance and brand desirability in the region.


Key Responsibilities

1. Regional Training Strategy & Execution

  • Own and execute the education strategy across South LATAM distributors and TR markets for fragrance, makeup, and skincare categories.
  • Adapt global training materials into impactful, locally relevant training modules (in-person and digital).
  • Develop and manage the regional training calendar, ensuring alignment with product launches and commercial priorities.
  • Deliver high-quality training across key markets, ensuring consistency and excellence in execution.
  • Manage the training budget for the region, ensuring efficient allocation of resources aligned with business priorities.
  • Partner and maintain close communication with Fashion boutique teams to execute training initiatives, ensuring alignment with brand standards and elevating client experience.


2. Distributor Partnership & Capability Building

  • Act as the main education liaison for distributors across South LATAM.
  • Train and coach local trainers and retail teams to ensure scalable knowledge transfer.
  • Track training effectiveness through KPIs (sell-out, engagement, certification rates) and implement improvements.
  • Tailor training approaches based on market maturity, cultural nuances, and business needs.


3. Brand & Product Expertise

  • Serve as the regional expert across fragrance, makeup, and skincare, ensuring deep product and brand storytelling knowledge.
  • Lead all training-related aspects of product launches, ensuring teams are fully prepared prior to market activation.
  • Elevate in-store execution standards through coaching on client experience, selling techniques, and service rituals.


4. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Sales and Marketing teams to align training initiatives with business objectives and sell-out targets.
  • Collaborate with Communications, Digital, and Trade Marketing teams to ensure a consistent brand message across all touchpoints.
  • Maintain alignment with brand DNA and guidelines.


5. Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Drive adoption of digital learning platforms and hybrid training formats (virtual, e-learning, etc.).
  • Identify and share best-in-class training practices across markets to elevate regional performance.
  • Gather feedback from the field to continuously refine training content and approach.


Requirements & Skills

  • 5+ years in Training/Education within the beauty industry (fragrance, makeup, and skincare preferred).
  • Strong understanding of LATAM markets
  • Proven ability to design and deliver engaging training programs to diverse audiences.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and influence different stakeholders.
  • Solid understanding of retail environments, client experience, and sales drivers.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish and Portuguese .
  • Willingness to travel frequently across South LATAM

title: Senior Generative AI Engineer
description:
Descrição da Vaga


Estamos em busca de uma Pessoa Engenheira de IA Generativa para atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de soluções inteligentes baseadas em Large Language Models (LLMs), agentes autônomos de IA e arquiteturas RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).

Esta pessoa será responsável por conceber, desenvolver e operacionalizar aplicações de IA em ambiente produtivo, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança, governança e alta performance. Buscamos um profissional com perfil inovador, visão arquitetural e experiência prática na integração de modelos de IA com sistemas corporativos e processos de negócio.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver e evoluir Agentes de IA para ambientes de produção.
  • Projetar, implementar e otimizar arquiteturas RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).
  • Desenvolver pipelines de ingestão, processamento, indexação e recuperação de dados.
  • Integrar LLMs a sistemas internos, APIs e plataformas corporativas.
  • Otimizar fluxos de inferência visando performance, escalabilidade e confiabilidade.
  • Implementar práticas de segurança, governança e qualidade para soluções de IA.
  • Participar da definição da arquitetura técnica e da evolução da plataforma de Inteligência Artificial.
  • Monitorar aplicações, realizar troubleshooting e promover melhorias contínuas.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para identificação de oportunidades de automação e inovação.
  • Documentar soluções técnicas, processos e padrões de desenvolvimento.


Requisitos e qualificações

Obrigatórios

  • Experiência com IA Generativa, LLMs e desenvolvimento de Agentes de IA.
  • Experiência na construção de arquiteturas RAG.
  • Domínio da linguagem Python.
  • Experiência com frameworks como LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex ou similares.

title: Instrutor(a) de Inglês – Aulas Online (Autônomo)
description:
Instrutor(a) de Inglês – Aulas Online (Autônomo)

Descrição da vaga:

Estamos em busca de instrutores de inglês fluentes para ministrar aulas online. Esta é uma oportunidade para profissionais autônomos que desejam atuar de forma remota, com flexibilidade de horários e possibilidade de ganhos conforme a disponibilidade de aulas.

Responsabilidades:

  • Ministrar aulas de inglês a alunos de diferentes níveis, de forma remota.
  • Cumprir a programação de aulas conforme combinado.
  • Elaborar relatórios mensais de aulas dadas para fins de pagamento.

Link de inscrição em nossa plataforma:

Requisitos:

  • Fluência no idioma inglês (oral e escrito).
  • Maior de 18 anos.
  • Computador com boa conexão de internet.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar de segunda a quinta-feira.
  • Espaço adequado para ministrar aulas online.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia como professor(a) ou instrutor(a) de inglês.
  • Disponibilidade no período noturno.

Tipo de contrato:

  • Prestador(a) de serviços (autônomo ou MEI).

Remuneração:

  • Pagamento por aula. A remuneração mensal pode variar conforme a carga horária assumida, podendo atingir uma média de R$2.200,00.

Local de trabalho:

  • Remoto / Home office.

Tipo de vaga: Autônomo

Pergunta(s) de seleção:

  • Você tem computador (ou laptop) e uma boa conexão de internet?

Idioma:

  • Inglês (Preferencial)
  • Localização do trabalho: Remoto

title: Associate II, Pharmacovigilance - Brazil - Remote
description:
What the Associate II, Pharmacovigilance does at Worldwide


Responsible for the collection, processing, evaluation and reporting of incoming Serious Adverse Event (SAE) data according to applicable regulatory guidelines/requirements, Worldwide Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and project specific instructions. Serves as Lead PV Associate on moderate to large sized studies that are moderate to complex in scope of work with moderate support from senior staff.


What you will do


  • Author Safety Management Plan for assigned studies
  • Attend and present at Investigator Meetings
  • Review incoming SAE data for completeness and accuracy
  • Perform data entry in the Safety Database and/or complete applicable tracking of incoming safety information
  • Perform QC of SAEs processed by other PV Associates
  • Generate regulatory reports and perform safety submissions as needed


What you will bring to the role


  • Strong understanding of medical and scientific terminology, of the principles of clinical assessment of adverse drug events, of international regulations and of reporting requirements
  • Strong understanding of computer technology, and management of relational database systems, including extraction of data
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to handle multiple competing priorities within tight timelines
  • Consistently demonstrates commitment, dependability, cooperation, adaptability and flexibility in executing daily tasks and responsibilities


Your experience


  • Minimum of 3 years of pharmacovigilance experience (pre-approval clinical trials)
  • Bachelor’s degree in science related field, nursing or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience
  • Computer literacy and strong working knowledge of MS Office applications (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent organization skills and attention to detail
  • Demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing priorities while adhering to applicable timelines
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize work effectively and work successfully in matrix team environment
  • Ability and willingness for potential limited travel (domestic and international) as needed (attend Investigator Meeting, project kick-off meeting and/or bid defense meeting)
  • Fluent in written and verbal English

title: Community Manager – RoboNeo Brazil
description:
Why We Need You:

RoboNeo ( is landing in Brazil, and we're building a creator community that can turn AI-powered imagination into reality. As our Community Manager, you'll be the one finding brilliant creators, getting them hooked on our tools, and fueling a movement that drives real user growth. This isn't managing an existing group — you'll build it from scratch in one of the most explosive markets for generative AI video. You'll work closely with product, marketing, and growth teams across different countries, and pick up skills that are only going to get more valuable. If you love AI, content, and the chaos of building something new, this is your spot.


What You'll Do:

· Scout and win over top AI creators across Brazil — identify talented voices, reach out, and get them excited about what RoboNeo can do;

· Own the relationship from first hello to long-term partnership — run interviews, onboard new creators, and keep the vibe strong with the people who matter most;

· Be the bridge between the community and our product — gather feedback, spot patterns, and help creators solve their real challenges with RoboNeo;

· Build and run training that actually helps — design educational flows, share pro tips, and level up the quality of content the community puts out;

· Keep a finger on the pulse with data — track community health every week, pull reports, and turn numbers into smarter moves that boost engagement.

title: Licensing Operations, & Financial Resolution Specialist
description:
Location: Brazil (100% Remote or Hybrid for Serra Gaúcha or São Paulo residents)

Compensation Currency: Brazilian Real (BRL)

Contract: Permanent Full Time (CLT) - 42h/week


About Us

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400+ employees and 70,000+ customers across 100+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.

Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end-to-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.

Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specialized in technology.


Role Purpose

This role ensures that customers receive the products, services, licences, and entitlements they have purchased — accurately and with minimal customer effort. The specialist resolves customer enquiries raised via Zendesk that relate to invoices, contracts in Salesforce, and related systems, acting as the operational owner for entitlement, billing, and data integrity matters within standard service levels.


Required Skills & Experience

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce and NetSuite (the team's go-forward systems); willingness and ability to learn additional legacy systems as needed
  • Prior experience with a ticketing tool such as Zendesk is a plus but not required
  • High level of English, written and spoken — the role requires clear communication with global, internal stakeholders
  • Strong written communication skills and attention to detail
  • Comfortable working across multiple, sometimes unfamiliar, IT systems
  • Able to work under pressure and manage competing priorities
  • Strong team player who collaborates across Sales, Finance, Operations, and Support

Core Responsibilities Entitlement & Licensing Management

  • Accurately assign licences and service entitlements and rapidly activate new purchases
  • Manage upgrades, downgrades, renewals, and licensee transfers/reassignments
  • Monitor licence allocation and usage; identify under- or over-utilised licences
  • Verify customers have access to all products and services purchased; audit and reconcile entitlements
  • Resolve entitlement discrepancies and prevent access interruptions
  • Interpret contractual entitlement rights and validate product, support, and service eligibility
  • Ensure alignment between contracts, orders, invoices, and entitlement systems, including for complex enterprise agreements

Billing & Invoice Support

  • Own customer billing enquiries end-to-end via Zendesk tickets, from first response through resolution
  • Investigate disputed charges and resolve invoice discrepancies, explaining charges, credits, and taxes clearly
  • Raise credit note requests and provide first-level approval of credit notes raised by other areas
  • Validate contract pricing and entitlements against billing records
  • Handle invoice, statement, and contract copy requests

Data Quality & Master Data Management

  • Maintain the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of customer, billing, and entitlement records
  • Identify and resolve data discrepancies and remove duplicate records
  • Validate data against source systems (Salesforce, NetSuite, and other platforms) and contractual agreements
  • Coordinate master data updates across CRM, billing, licensing, and support platforms
  • Process changes in billing frequency, currency, and historical contract corrections

Reconciliation, Change & Escalation Management

  • Reconcile data between systems and investigate root causes of mismatches
  • Support customer mergers, acquisitions, and organisational/account hierarchy changes
  • Coordinate with Sales, Operations, Finance, and Technical Support on business-critical issues
  • Own priority investigation and escalation of entitlement and data issues within defined SLAs

Reporting

  • Contribute to entitlement summaries, licence position, and renewal/expiry reporting (with the BI team)
  • Support data quality scorecards, customer data health assessments, and root-cause reporting

Service Expectations

  • Proactive: Monitor upcoming expirations and data anomalies; flag gaps before they affect the customer
  • Accurate: Get entitlement and data changes right first time, with full traceability
  • Responsive: Provide timely, reliable resolution within standard SLAs
  • Transparent: Give clear visibility into issue status, ownership, and resolution

title: Head of Business & Operations (Brazil Resident)
description:
About the company

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet.


Why this role

We are entering the Brazilian market as a Banco Central do Brasil-authorised Virtual Asset Service Provider, and you would be our first Business & Operations Officer on the ground. Under BCB Resolution 520/2025, VASPs are required to designate a statutory director responsible for conducting the institution's business and ensuring alignment with its commercial and strategic objectives — this is that seat. In your first year, you will have established the operational foundation of Gate's Brazil entity, built the company's commercial presence in the market, and ensured our business activities run in full alignment with the BCB's regulatory expectations.


What you'll do

  • Hold statutory director responsibility for business conduct and operations at a BCB-authorised VASP, with personal accountability for acting in good faith and in the company's best interest
  • Oversee and conduct the institution's day-to-day business activities, ensuring alignment with Gate's commercial strategy and operational objectives in Brazil
  • Act as the primary operational interface between Gate's Brazil entity and its regional and global leadership, translating strategic direction into local execution
  • Maintain personal fitness and propriety; disclose, without prompting, anything that touches your fitness, propriety, or potential conflicts — to the company and to the BCB
  • Drive the VASP authorisation process forward on the business and operations workstream, including declarations and documentation the BCB requests on its own timeline
  • Discharge any additional duties prescribed by applicable Brazilian laws, regulations, or by the company


What you'll bring

Must-have

  • Brazilian permanent residency or citizenship , with the ability to maintain ordinary residency in Brazil for as long as the role requires
  • You hold no competing statutory director or officer seat at another regulated entity in Brazil
  • A predominantly commercial and operational profile — you have led or co-led a business unit, market expansion, or operational function, not just supported one
  • Prior experience at a BCB-regulated financial institution, fintech, or crypto/VASP — familiarity with how regulated entities operate in Brazil is essential
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, written and spoken
  • Willing to undergo a full BCB fit-and-proper review and disclose what it requires


Nice-to-have

  • Prior experience in the crypto or digital asset industry
  • Direct prior engagement with BCB on regulatory filings, inspections, or authorisation processes
  • Academic background or postgraduate training in business, finance, economics, or law
